title: Sharp training-conditional coverage for conformal prediction under covariate shift
summary: Weighted split conformal prediction reweights calibration scores by the likelihood ratio between the test and training covariate distributions and guarantees marginal coverage under covariate shift. We study its coverage conditional on the calibration data.
